en.title: Fallout: New Vegas Modders Drop Van Buren Pip-Boy Design
en.summary: A dedicated team of modders has brought a piece of lost Fallout history to life in Fallout: New Vegas. They've released a new Pip-Boy model directly inspired by the cancelled Black Isle Studios title, codenamed Van Buren.
en.body:
The spirit of Fallout's cancelled third entry, **Van Buren**, is alive and kicking thanks to a passionate modding community. Last week, coinciding with the in-universe date of the Great War, October 23rd, the developers behind the ambitious **Fallout: The New West** project unveiled a significant new asset for **Fallout: New Vegas**: a Pip-Boy design straight from **Van Buren**'s original concept documents.

This isn't just a cosmetic change; it's a deep dive into the series' history. **Van Buren**, originally helmed by **Black Isle Studios**, was intended to be the true sequel to **Fallout 2** before **Bethesda Game Studios** acquired the IP. While the project was ultimately cancelled, its design documents and ambitious ideas have continued to inspire fans and modders for years. The **Fallout: The New West** team has previously released weapons inspired by the canned game, but this new Pip-Boy is the star of their latest drop, offering a unique visual flair that echoes the franchise's roots.

## A Functional Piece of Fallout History

This isn't the first time fans have seen a functional Pip-Boy replica. The **Wand Company** previously released a highly detailed, wearable **Pip-Boy 3000** replica for **Fallout 3** and **Fallout: New Vegas**. This official merchandise boasted a die-cast metal casing, an IPS LCD screen mimicking the retro CRT interface with scanlines and glitches, and over 2,200 in-game entries. It was developed using original **Bethesda Game Studios** design geometry and additional details from art director **Istvan Pely**'s high-poly model, showcasing a commitment to authenticity that resonates with the fanbase.

## Community's Embrace of the Past

The release of a **Van Buren**-inspired Pip-Boy taps directly into the desire for lost content and alternate realities within the Fallout universe. Modders have a long history of bringing unreleased or forgotten elements into existing games, allowing players to experience what might have been. This particular mod is a testament to the enduring legacy of **Van Buren** and the creativity of the **Fallout: New Vegas** modding scene, which continues to be one of the most active and inventive in gaming. Fans have shown immense enthusiasm for these historical nods, often requesting further integration of older concepts into modern titles.

## What's Next

The **Fallout: The New West** team continues to develop their ambitious project, and further asset releases inspired by **Van Buren** are expected. Players eager to experience this piece of Fallout history can download the new Pip-Boy model for **Fallout: New Vegas** now.

content_raw: One of the days last week was October 23rd. It's the date in the Fallout universe when the bombs dropped and has morphed into a time for yearly community happenings plus, in Bethesda's case, usually some marketing. Sometimes, modders behind long-running projects time up standalone releases with it, as has been the case this year with the folks behind Fallout: The New West , the project aiming to make their own version of Black Isle Studios' cancelled third Fallout game. They've released a few guns inspired by the canned entry, which you may know by its codename Van Buren, but the headliner from this gear drop for New Vegas is a funky new Pip-Boy design. Read more
